note: Every asset path appears once and points at a credit template. Templates are taken only from existing Lamplight credit and license files (LICENSE, LICENSE-CONTENT including the former LICENSES.md map, gallery manifests, soundcards-u13.js CREDITS, and the Credits section of the previous README). If an asset is not named in those sources, source/author/license/url are "unknown". Nothing here was guessed. The app's visible credits were not changed. A rule with a prefix applies to every shipped file under that path. Assets listed under "assets" are the ones not covered by a prefix rule.
